info.name: Substrate API Sidecar accounts rc runtime API
Get version information of the relay chain Substrate runtime.

params.name: at
params.description: Block at which to retrieve runtime version information at.

items.docs: Returns version information related to the relay chain runtime. This endpoint is specifically for Asset Hub and queries the relay chain (Polkadot/Kusama) for runtime specification.

params.name: at
params.description: Block hash or height at which to query. If not provided, queries finalized head.

items.docs: Returns the relay chain's runtime metadata in decoded JSON format. This endpoint is specifically for Asset Hub and queries the relay chain (Polkadot/Kusama) for metadata.

info.name: Get the available versions of relay chain's metadata.

params.name: at
params.description: Block hash or height at which to query. If not provided, queries finalized head.

items.docs: Returns the available versions of the relay chain's metadata. This endpoint is specifically for Asset Hub and queries the relay chain (Polkadot/Kusama) for metadata versions.

info.name: Get the relay chain's metadata at a specific version.

params.name: metadataVersion
params.description: The specific version of the Metadata to query. The input must conform to the 'vX' format, where 'X' represents the version number (examples 'v14', 'v15').

params.name: at
params.description: Block hash or height at which to query. If not provided, queries finalized head.

items.docs: Returns the relay chain's runtime metadata at a specific version in decoded JSON format. This endpoint is specifically for Asset Hub and queries the relay chain (Polkadot/Kusama) for versioned metadata.

info.name: Get the Wasm code blob of the relay chain Substrate runtime.

params.name: at
params.description: Block at which to retrieve runtime code information at.

items.docs: Returns the relay chain's runtime code in Wasm format. This endpoint is specifically for Asset Hub and queries the relay chain (Polkadot/Kusama) for runtime code.
